# Widgets

<!-- Generated by `bun run docs` from packages/core/src/widgets/catalog. Do not edit by hand. -->

StatusCraft has 43 bricks. Examples show a busy session.

## 🤖 Model & Session

| Brick | Type | Example | What it shows |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 🤖 Model | `model` | `Opus 5.5` | The Claude model you are talking to (options: format) |
| 💪 Effort | `effort` | `Effort high` | Reasoning effort level (low to max) |
| 💭 Thinking | `thinking` | `thinking` | Shows when extended thinking is on |
| ⚡ Fast Mode | `fast-mode` | (hidden) | Shows when fast mode is on |
| 🎨 Output Style | `output-style` | `Style default` | The active output style |
| 🏷️ Session Name | `session-name` | `refactor-auth` | The session title (set with /rename or generated) |
| 🔑 Session ID | `claude-session-id` | `SID 3f2a9c1e` | First characters of the session id |
| 🕵️ Agent | `agent` | (hidden) | The agent name when running with --agent |
| ⌨️ Vim Mode | `vim-mode` | `INSERT` | NORMAL / INSERT when vim mode is on |
| 🔖 Claude Code Version | `version` | `v2.1.289` | The Claude Code version |

## 🧠 Context & Tokens

| Brick | Type | Example | What it shows |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 🧠 Context % | `context-percentage` | `Ctx 56%` | How full the context window is (warning colors; options: show) |
| 📊 Context Bar | `context-bar` | `██████░░░░ 56%` | A progress bar of the context window (warning colors; options: width, style, percent) |
| 📏 Context Tokens | `context-length` | `Tokens 112k` | Tokens in the context window (options: showMax) |
| 🧯 Usable Context % | `context-percentage-usable` | `Usable 70%` | Share of the context you can use before auto-compact (80% of the window) (warning colors) |
| 📥 Input Tokens | `tokens-input` | `In 112k` | Input tokens in the context window (cache included) |
| 📤 Output Tokens | `tokens-output` | `Out 6.4k` | Output tokens of the latest answer |
| 🗄️ Cached Tokens | `tokens-cached` | `Cached 97k` | Tokens read from the prompt cache on the latest request |
| 🧮 Total Tokens | `tokens-total` | `Total 118k` | Input plus output tokens in the context window |
| 🔥 Prompt Cache | `prompt-cache` | `Cache warm 91%` | Whether the prompt cache is warm, and its hit ratio (warning colors) |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Command widgets execute only after an explicit approval in the local editor or with `npx statuscraft trust` (`--project` for a project layout). Shared/imported layouts cannot approve themselves. Commands run with your user permissions; see [backups and command safety](../README.md#backups-and-command-safety).
